Mithril Gourmand

The Mithril Gourmand is an active event that can happen in the  Dwarven Mines.

Contents

  • 1 Mechanics
    • 1.1 Rewards
  • 2 Game Message
  • 3 Tips
  • 4 History
  • 5 Navigation

Mechanics

[edit | edit source]

During the event, certain area in the  Dwarven Mines will be selected, and in there mining  Mithril Ore will have a 30% chance to drop a  Tasty Mithril.  100–200 Tasty Mithril has to be given to Don Expresso to complete the event.

Mithril Gourmand event lasts for 10 minutes. If requirement is fulfilled, timer will be shortened to 1 minute.

Rewards

[edit | edit source]

If the player gives Don Expresso at least  10 Tasty Mithril, they will gain extra rewards. Similarly to the Raffle event, players need to bring the items to a specific location, this location can be reached with the command /tptodonexpresso. Also similarly to Raffle, collected Tasty Mithril is only useful in the event during which it has been obtained.

Tips

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Mithril Powder § Increasing Mithril Powder Gain
  • Players can use the Royal reforge to increase their gain of ᠅ Mithril Powder from this and other Mining Events.
  • It is recommended to wait until the last minute to cash in  Tasty Mithril clumps as the individual ᠅ Mithril Powder reward scale with the amount of  Tasty Mithril donated. This allows for all participants to fully benefit from the event.
